language.name: Kestrel Matchday Kinetic
language.rationale: Built on Kestrel Athletic's high-contrast Volt and Carbon palette, using Anton's punchy condensed silhouette, sharp geometry, and crisp snap transitions to capture matchday velocity and clear broadcast legibility.

notes: structure and spacing: platform-owned (compact density - 18/25px padding, 8px line gap, at scale 1)
accent: a bar fused to the panel's leading edge, outside its padding
motion: snap at fast pace → preset slide-up
